name: rank_by_ta
description: Rank symbols by weighted technical analysis scores across timeframes. Useful for comparing which symbols have the strongest overall TA signals.

symbols.description: Array of ticker symbols to rank (e.g., ['NASDAQ:AAPL', 'NASDAQ:MSFT', 'NASDAQ:NVDA']). Maximum 50.

weights.description: Per-timeframe weights for ranking. Unspecified timeframes default to weight 1. Example: {"1D": 3, "1W": 2}
